import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset
data = """
date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36

"""

import pandas as pd

date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36

2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Convert date and time columns to datetime format
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.time

# Group by product and average total
avg_total = df.groupby('product')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=avg_total.index, y=avg_total.values)
